column1: Total Comments Supporting the Bike Lane: 49
The Humboldt Street bike lane provides a vital route for residents to commute to work, access transit, and reach downtown destinations.
The bike lane prevents traffic violence and protects cyclists from dangerous conditions on narrow streets.
The Humboldt Street bike lane is a critical component of the Safe Route to Schools network, enabling students to safely bike to school.
Removing the bike lane would abandon the city's commitment to sustainability and environmental responsibility.
The city should prioritize fiscal responsibility by maintaining the infrastructure investment already made in the bike lane.
The bike lane has displaced 200 parking spaces needed by residents in the North Central neighborhood.
Residents of North Central, particularly those living on Humboldt Street, have been unfairly burdened by the removal of parking spaces for the benefit of a small number of cyclists.
Special interest groups with significant resources have monopolized the decision-making process and overwhelmed the voices of affected residents.
The bike lane serves only a small number of cyclists while displacing many more people who depend on street parking.
Community Development Block Grant funds were misappropriated and not intended to be used for a dedicated bike lane installation.
